newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures finish firmer, funds still buyers.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures finish firmer, funds still buyers.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures extended recent gains to close firmer amid brisk fund buying, trading sources said.
July climbed over nearby resistance pegged at a gap on the charts between 84.90 and 85.00 cents a lb to a new seven-week high of 86.75 cents.
Traders pegged the next upside target at the high of 87.45 cents reached March 25, followed by 88.00 cents.

July juice closed up 0.80 cent at 85.70 cents after trading from 86.75 to 83.25 cents. Second-position September finished up 1.00 at 87.65 cents, while the rest of the board closed 0.85 to 0.50 firmer.
An estimated 4,000 lots changed hands on the day against Friday's official 5,785 lots.
